short_description: A viral duo compact of powder and cream blush formulas to achieve long-wearing bold color that melts into skin for a beautiful, radiant glow.
long_description: What it is: A viral duo compact of powder and cream blush formulas to achieve long-wearing bold color that melts into skin for a beautiful, radiant glow. how_to_use: Suggested Usage: -For a sheer look and dewy glow, dab and blend the cream formula on cheeks. -For a soft, airbrushed finish, sweep the powder onto the apples of the cheeks with a fluffy blush brush. -For ultimate color payoff, layer the cream formula over the powder for a glossy, dimensional look. -For best results, pair with Patrick Ta Dual Ended Blush Brush (sold separately).

long_description: What it is: A long-wearing baked blush that’s non-comedogenic and lightweight for a diffused flush of color. Highlighted Ingredients: - Plant-Derived Squalane and Glycerin: Help moisturize and soften dry skin. - Hyaluronic Acid: Locks in moisture to hydrate skin. - Ethically Sourced Silica and Mica: Helps to blur skin with a natural, diffused finish. Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. What Else You Need to Know: Luxurious and plush, SuperSuede™ blush has easy pickup and effortless, breathable color payoff. Its lightweight, velvet texture melts into skin seamlessly, blurs without silicones, and is never patchy, cakey or drying. We recommend storing SuperSuede™ out of direct sunlight or harsh lighting when not in use.
how_to_use: Suggested Usage: With a light hand, DIP flat side of Powder Blush Brush into SuperSuede™. -Gently TAP off excess pigment from bristles for a controlled, even application. -Softly SWEEP brush over apples of the cheeks and up toward the temples. Repeat to build pigment. - Stack SuperSuede™ on top of Dew Blush Liquid Cream Blush (sold separately) to intensify color and set. -SaieGlow™ Pro Artist Tip: - Use one side of the Powder Blush Brush's bristles to apply pigment and the opposite clean side to blend.
